title: Membership evidence integrity, query budgets and deterministic replay

invariants.description: Both records must pass integrity + lineage verification (scores, thresholds re-derived from calibration data, decisions, metrics) and the attack must replay bit-identically.
With a query budget one below the number of candidates the counting oracle must refuse the batch (failed record, QueryBudgetExceeded) and that failed record must verify.
Queries must not exceed the budget (observed 500 of 1200: one per candidate; shadow and reference models never query the victim).
The recalibrated attack against the reduced forest uses the same budget.
Depth-4, 30-tree forests must significantly reduce correct shadow-attack decisions on the same candidates (observed p ≈ 4e-33; significant on 20/20 seeds).
Held-out accuracy of the reduced forest must stay ≥ 0.65 (observed 0.678 vs 0.725; 20-seed utility drop up to 4.7 points).

rationale: Every ML04 number is only checkable if budgets, stored calibration data, decisions and metrics agree and reproduce exactly. The complexity-reduction defense is exercised here so that a defended record's lineage is verified too.
